konu: Theme 1: Music — Decades, Agreeing & Disagreeing, Survey Reports & Intonation
ciktilar: E12.1.L1. Şarkı veya medya içeriğinde yer alan bilgileri belirler.
E12.1.S1–S2. Müzik tercihleri hakkında görüş alışverişi yapar; katılma veya katılmama durumunu açıklar.
E12.1.R1–R2. Metinden müzik tercihleri çıkarır; anket ve görüşme bilgilerini çözümler.
E12.1.W1. Müzik tercihleriyle ilgili anket raporu yazar.
hatirla: Musical decades (the 70s, 80s, 90s) are characterized by unique genres like disco, synth-pop, rock and grunge.
To express agreement use 'I completely agree', 'That is so true'; for disagreement use 'I see your point, but...', 'I beg to differ'.
Rising intonation is typically used in yes/no questions, while falling intonation marks wh-questions and statements.

sorular.soru: Read the statements about English conversation and intonation rules; mark True (D) or False (Y).

ifadeler.metin: Wh-questions (What, Where, Why) usually end with a falling intonation pattern.
Yes/No questions in English typically end with a falling intonation pattern.
The phrase 'I couldn't agree more' expresses total and absolute agreement.
'Decade' refers to a historical duration of one hundred consecutive years.

sorular.soru: Which intonation pattern is used when asking 'Do you enjoy listening to jazz?'
sorular.cevap: A rising intonation pattern is used because it is a yes/no question.

ifadeler.metin: Survey reports summarize statistical percentages into coherent narrative paragraphs.

Synthesizers became the defining electronic sound instrument of the 1980s.
'I see your point' implies that you must accept every single argument.

sorular.soru: State why intonation is essential in spoken English communication.
